# Huntsville Independent Press

> > Alabama's premier independent publisher providing comprehensive publishing services from manuscript editing to book printing for authors seeking professional support.

Huntsville Independent Press (HIP) is an Alabama-based independent publishing house that offers full-service publishing solutions including editorial services, printing, and distribution. The publisher works with authors across multiple genres including fiction, memoir, fantasy, and devotional works, maintaining a curated catalog of published titles.

## Key Topics

- Independent Publishing
- Manuscript Editing
- Book Printing & Binding

- Developmental Editing
- Book Production

## Publishing Services

- [How to Publish With HIP](https://www.huntsvilleindependent.com/publish-with-us): Publishing partnership process and models for authors submitting to HIP
- [Professional Manuscript Editing | Line, Copy & Developmental](https://www.huntsvilleindependent.com/editorial): HIP's editorial services including developmental editing and proofreading
- [Book Printing | HIP](https://www.huntsvilleindependent.com/printing): Book printing and binding services including hardcover and paperback options
- [FAQs | HIP](https://www.huntsvilleindependent.com/faqs): Publishing FAQs covering submission guidelines and editorial standards

## Published Authors & Works

- [Our Authors](https://www.huntsvilleindependent.com/authors): Directory of published authors including Faye R. DesPres and Grant Rolley
- [Branded | HIP](https://www.huntsvilleindependent.com/product-page/branded): Product page for thriller novel Branded by Jackson Pierce
- [The Ohio Kids Meet Elvis Presley | HIP](https://www.huntsvilleindependent.com/product-page/the-ohio-kids-meet-elvis-presley): Young adult mystery featuring The Ohio Kids meeting Elvis Presley
- [Shadow of Okeaous | HIP](https://www.huntsvilleindependent.com/product-page/shadow-of-okeaous): Fantasy novel by Maggie Bennett featuring epic adventure and elemental magic

## Memoir & Autobiography

- [My Own Ashes | HIP](https://www.huntsvilleindependent.com/product-page/my-own-ashes): Memoir exploring addiction recovery and philosophy by Kirk
- [Nature Man | HIP](https://www.huntsvilleindependent.com/product-page/nature-man): Memoir by Anthony Genaro about childhood trauma in Staten Island orphanage
- [And They Called Me Bigfoot | HIP](https://www.huntsvilleindependent.com/product-page/they-called-me-bigfoot-1): Autobiography of Robert 'Bigfoot' Clemens and American Dream story

## Specialty & Devotional Works

- [Glory: The Devotional | HIP](https://www.huntsvilleindependent.com/product-page/glory-the-devotional): 31-day Christian devotional based on Psalm 23 for spiritual growth
- [Save It For Therapy | HIP](https://www.huntsvilleindependent.com/product-page/save-it-for-therapy): Mental health journal and therapy workbook product by Huntsville Independent
